bar-chart: div: role={interactive() ? 'button' : null}, aria-label={interactive() ? entryLabel(entry) : null}
column-series: svg: role={interactive() ? 'button' : null}, aria-label={interactive() ? entryLabel(mark) : null}
pie-chart: path: role={ringCarriesTheRoute() ? 'button' : null}, aria-label={ringCarriesTheRoute() ? entryLabel(entry) : null}
li: role={interactive() ? 'button' : null}, aria-label={interactive() ? entryLabel(entry) : null}
funnel-chart: polygon: role={interactive() ? 'button' : null}, aria-label={interactive() ? entryLabel(entry) : null}
line-chart: circle: role={interactive() ? 'button' : null}, aria-label={interactive() ? markerLabel(entry, marker) : null}
line-series: svg: role={interactive() ? 'button' : null}, aria-label={interactive() ? markerLabel(marker) : null}
scatter-chart: circle: role={interactive() ? 'button' : null}, aria-label={interactive() ? pointLabel(entry.series, mark.point) : null}
